subject.title: improve(ci): preserve complete main validation during merge bursts

question: Should maintainers approve the protected-main ruleset and operational rollout for the exact-identity sticky-disk deletion workflow together with the main single-flight CI policy?
rationale: The repository diff can constrain identities, but it cannot establish the required GitHub default-branch ruleset or safely demonstrate the Blacksmith deletion path without an authorized operational environment.

options.title: Authorize a protected-main rehearsal
options.body: Verify the ruleset, main-run coalescing, cache-warm trigger, and a manifest-rejected cleanup invocation before merging.

options.title: Split cleanup from concurrency
options.body: Merge the non-destructive CI scheduling change separately and defer the deletion workflow until the operational controls are independently approved.

options.title: Pause the rollout
options.body: Keep the current cancellation/deletion procedures until an owner accepts the new operational boundary.

recommendation.title: Authorize a protected-main rehearsal
recommendation.body: Verify the ruleset, main-run coalescing, cache-warm trigger, and a manifest-rejected cleanup invocation before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the recent contributor with merged history in the same cache and sticky-disk lifecycle area.
